comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Statue of Narasimha

Further Research Quest name: Further Research into Narasimha
Skill requirement: r8 Search, r10 Theology, THA(Thai/Burmese)
Pre-requisite discovery: The Statue of Narasimha discovery (from "Statue with the head of a lion" quest) + The Statue of Vishnu discovery (from "God there at the beginning" quest)
Required Sophia rank: 3
Sophia cost: 300 points
